## 4. Academic Research & Publications

### PostureSense: Real-Time Posture Detection and Correction Using MediaPipe and Computer Vision
- **Year**: 2024
- **Status**: Peer-Reviewed Publication
- **Research Areas**: Computer Vision, MediaPipe, Pose Landmark Estimation, Real-Time Systems, Human-Centered AI.
- **Abstract**: PostureSense introduces an AI-driven, real-time posture correction system utilizing MediaPipe pose landmark estimation and computer vision. The system analyzes posture geometry from standard webcam video feeds without requiring specialized wearable sensors or hardware, delivering immediate corrective feedback to users to prevent ergonomic strain.
- **Reference URL**: https://vedaangsharma.in/research/posturesense

## 6. Key Projects & Engineering Case Studies

### 1. Posture Sense
- **Overview**: Real-time AI posture detection and ergonomic guidance system.
- **Technologies**: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, React, Next.js, WebSockets.
- **Architecture**: Ingests video frames via client webcam, extracts 33 standard skeletal landmarks, computes ergonomic angles in real-time, and generates non-intrusive posture alerts.
- **Project URL**: https://vedaangsharma.in/projects/posture-sense

### 2. FlyRank Grounded AI Assistant (Ask Vedaang)
- **Overview**: First-person interactive AI conversational assistant grounded strictly in portfolio knowledge.
- **Technologies**: Next.js API Routes, Streaming SSE, Vector Knowledge Base, Cloudflare Turnstile, Upstash Redis Rate Limiting.
- **Architecture**: Enforces strict grounding rules, streaming responses, and first-person entity voice without hallucination.
- **Live Interface**: https://vedaangsharma.in/ask

### 3. BehaviourSim
- **Overview**: Agent-based behavioral simulation and multi-agent modeling framework.
- **Technologies**: Python, State Machines, Data Visualization.
